protocol.execution_requires: Independent fine joint witness, then freeze W_CONTROLLED_PRIOR before any new observation. Original undefined minimum_feature is not retroactively PASS.
protocol.direct_adaptive_control: Before fresh observation generation, add full3 plus directly integrated truncated order3 CDF control. Compare with5/9 under identical tolerances and cache rights. This strengthens the ordinary direct baseline; it does not alter the reference gate or any prior.
protocol.reference: Direct full-Maxwell positive quadrature with one proper shared complex gain marginalized once. Independent order and truncated-CDF checks. Numerical empirical reliability, not general continuous PDE certification.
protocol.compression: Separate branch-specific tensor response interpolation; retain branch priors and target conditional dependence. Compare direct adaptive quadrature with equal cache rights, including setup, validation and all fallback.

finite_material_rule.main_evaluator: Every node is an actual paid full Maxwell vector; exact tuple reuse permitted with provenance. No response interpolation in the main four-arm comparison.
finite_material_rule.purpose: Finite quadrature of the unchanged continuous controlled prior; independent truncated Full5/9 CDF qualification on EACH new observation.

point_full_validation.failure_fallback: Global shared-gain profile over the paid full9 nodes; log all failures and actual costs. Main full65x5 point arms normally use already paid actual full-bank responses.

scoring.replicas: average two noise replicas within each parent
secondary: all setup, correction and validation costs

P1B.posterior_position_mean: Bayes action for position loss within the controlled prior; may lie between disconnected position intervals and is not a new physical world.
P1B.correctness: Exact Full-Maxwell likelihood on finite GL65x5 quadrature nodes with shared-gain quadrature. Finite target still requires empirical comparison against independently integrated continuous reference. Correct MH ratios and repeated states retained.

zero_observation_control.scope: Unconditional controlled-prior Bayes action, not a posterior estimate

protocol.truth_use: Generation and separate offline scoring only; online quadrature/proposal code reads observation-only file.
protocol.stopping: Unqualified reference cannot support calibrated P1-B claims; retain failures and independent numerical diagnostics. No extra stage budget.

public_prior.intended_scope: independent restricted simulation family; not general unknown-wall online inference

wall_support.definition: original analytic wall support shared by both branches
wall_support.chart: LinearWorld54 nonnegative tensor hats/108 bounded affine parameters
wall_support.q1: fixed independently validated endpoint copied verbatim

nuisance.shared: ONE gamma for every frequency/source/receiver; external multiply only

acquisition.source_normalization: Unit line-source Green, constant multiplier 1 at every frequency; known calibrated source spectrum
acquisition.whitening: full Re/Im norm divided by.01, no channel-count normalization

nomination_snapshot.nomination_rule: First predeclared seed2 direct-joint ordinaryFullJ point with d<=1; randomized control completed before validation

public_prior.observation_or_truth_generation: NONE; handled only by a separate explicitly authorized process
public_prior.probability_origin: new explicit controlled prior masses; not inferred from witness existence or likelihood fit
public_prior.boundary_roundoff: only one outward float64ULP maps back to its same frozen boundary

response_source.meaning: 650 paid complete Maxwell material vectors; finite quadrature of unchanged continuous prior

nuisance_selected_rule: lower checked order;65unqualified if no agreement
finite_rule: fixed GL65u/GL5contrast full-Maxwell-node quadrature approximation to unchanged continuous controlled prior
